title: HEART: Human-centric Ethical Audit and Revision Toolkit for Benchmarks
description: HEART is a resource package for auditing and revising AI-ethics benchmarks. It contains a 103-entry benchmark corpus, 14 diagnostic rubrics, 14 generic repair tools, 103 benchmark-specific repair sub-tools, five worked mini cases, and anonymized pilot expert A/B validation results.
